semantic_cases.name: authority_pair_is_complete_external_identity
semantic_cases.given: the same principal_id exists on two Stations
semantic_cases.action: compare accounts, memberships, Contacts or grants
invariants: PCR ids and receipt digests are not equality inputs
each Station enforces create-once lineage uniqueness for its pair

semantic_cases.name: same_core_two_station_accounts_never_merge_state
semantic_cases.given: the same normalized principal_id completes onboarding independently on Station A and Station B
semantic_cases.action: resolve, sync, federate, recover or operate either AccountId
invariants: AccountId A and AccountId B differ because station_id differs
Event history and PCR lineage never migrate, merge or inherit across the two AccountIds
device context and active generation never merge or authorize the other AccountId
session grants and cursors are valid only for their original AccountId and Station audience
to-device queues and push registrations remain partitioned by their original AccountId
Station admission proofs remain signed by and attributable to the original station_id
neither Station may take over, redirect or rewrite the other Station's data lineage
DID representation, DID Document, handle and service route changes do not alter either AccountId

semantic_cases.name: deactivated_pair_rejects_local_replacement_account
semantic_cases.given: an account for (principal_id, station_id) is deactivated and its lifetime uniqueness tombstone remains
semantic_cases.action: create a replacement account for the same pair on that Station
invariants: deactivation never releases pair uniqueness
no second PCR lineage or account_id is allocated on the same Station

semantic_cases.name: deactivated_pair_policy_denies_reactivation
semantic_cases.given: the original account is deactivated and the deployment account-governance policy denies reactivation
semantic_cases.action: request recovery completion for that same account and PCR
invariants: no account status, PCR, session or device authority write occurs
pair uniqueness and the original account binding remain reserved

semantic_cases.name: account_auth_cannot_reactivate_without_pcr_recovery
semantic_cases.given: the original account is deactivated and fresh account authentication or admin approval succeeds but no completed PCR recovery closure exists
semantic_cases.action: request active status or a Standard grant
invariants: account authentication and admin policy do not authorize a PCR replacement device
current DID control is insufficient unless the accepted PCR recovery policy enabled that factor

semantic_cases.name: completed_recovery_reactivates_original_account
semantic_cases.given: the original account is deactivated, deployment policy allows reactivation, and the same PCR has a verified completed recovery receipt and completion attestation for a higher current device generation
invariants: the original account_id, authority pair and PCR lineage are unchanged
the Account Authority appends exactly one deactivated-to-active successor
the Standard grant binds the exact replacement device authorization Event and new generation
old sessions, devices, KeyPackages, delegations, push routes and pending deliveries remain terminal

semantic_cases.name: deactivated_principal_may_onboard_at_another_station
semantic_cases.given: an account is deactivated on Station A
semantic_cases.action: create a service account for the same principal_id on Station B
invariants: the new account has a distinct station_id and account_id
the old account, session, device and KeyPackage resources remain terminal
onboarding at another Station is an independent holder choice, not a mandatory deactivation recovery path

semantic_cases.name: account_actor_origin_is_producer_signed
semantic_cases.given: a producer proof validates the canonical Event

semantic_cases.name: delegated_author_uses_executor_account
invariants: actor_id remains the business principal of record
authorization_ref proves executor authority

semantic_cases.name: wrong_origin_service_cannot_admit
semantic_cases.given: a valid producer Event author ActorId routes to Station A
semantic_cases.action: Station B appends an admission proof
invariants: admission verification_method controller must project to the origin service derived from the exact author ActorId

semantic_cases.name: admission_binds_exact_producer_proof
semantic_cases.given: the Event digest is unchanged but the producer proof object is replaced

semantic_cases.name: pending_device_cannot_gain_new_admission
semantic_cases.given: the local device generation has at least one durable revocation_pending record
invariants: no station_admission proof is appended
pending is reconstructed from the durable proposal/Ack/decision/Seal store rather than cache

semantic_cases.name: historical_admission_survives_later_revocation
semantic_cases.given: an admission proof was lawfully created before revocation_pending
semantic_cases.action: verify the historical accepted Event offline
invariants: accepted_at is evaluated at admission time
no current device-state query is required

semantic_cases.name: replica_preserves_origin_proof
semantic_cases.given: a federation or backfill replica receives an accepted Event
invariants: replica does not remove or replace the origin proof
replica does not append its own admission proof
